activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, and kitchen management. I receive the delivery, check quantities and temperatures, sharpen the prep plan around anything missing, and keep the kitchen moving through inspection-preparation tasks.
Carry my work things to the entryway, place my keys deliberately there while I put on my shoes, and leave for the studio.
Work at the studio on the major presentation and planting-plan revisions, checking the narrative, drawings, and priorities in sequence.
Attend a site visit and review planting conditions, light, circulation, and maintenance implications.
Eat a simple lunch and make brief notes before the afternoon meetings.
Continue studio work and client coordination, refining the presentation details and preparing the materials that need to be defensible tomorrow.
Attend the community garden committee meeting and discuss maintenance priorities and the budget disagreements.
Collect my backpack, knife roll, phone, and keys, then leave for the evening shift.
Run dinner service and closing duties. I lead the line through the rush, finish the Wednesday preparation list, close down the stations, and carry the thermos home with me.
